newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Arab bank approves $31.9 mln African projects.
newsitem.headline: Arab bank approves $31.9 mln African projects.

text.p: The Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa (BADEA) has approved development loans and grants for projects totalling $31.9 million, the Moroccan news agency MAP said on Thursday.
It said the bank council approved the finance at a meeting in the Moroccan city of Marrakesh this week.

The main projects were an $8 million upgrading of a road in Senegal, and two drinking water networks, each totalling $10 million, in Eritrea and Burkina Faso. Other smaller amounts of financial aid were approved for Lesotho, Congo, Chad, Togo, Sierra Leone and Mozambique.
